note: Forward-only: no backtest rows enter this scoreboard (MRI-R8). Primary metrics use evaluation-eligible rows only; all_forward preserves the immutable raw record.

claims.expectation_read_hit_rate_note: Fraction of prints where actual fell in the same band as frozen expectation_read tag (above_expectations / below_expectations / aligned, ±0.35·σ_scale). Display-only (MRI-R22). Null until data accrues.
claims.pinball_loss_5q_note: MRI-R31: 5-quantile pinball loss sum (p10+p25+p50+p75+p90 mean losses). Reported-only; lower is better. Skew display marked descriptive_until_n24.
claims.block_note: MRI-R9: weekly claims residuals have strong autocorrelation. Reported MAE and coverage are computed on individual weekly prints; effective sample size is smaller than n due to serial correlation. Era-split results in research/release_forecast/CLAIMS_BACKTEST.md are the authoritative reference.

score_receipts.note: Official actual receipts supersede same-vintage proxies and legacy calculations for evaluation; every receipt remains in the ledger.

defect_notices.affects: all CPI and CPI_CORE projection + shadow rows with asof_night 2026-07-07 through 2026-07-13 (periods 2026-06 and 2026-07)
defect_notices.defect: sticky/median/flex features double-differenced: _last_n_mom_lags applied pct_change() to STICKCPIM157SFRBATL, FLEXCPIM157SFRBATL, and MEDCPIM158SFRBCLE, which are already published as percent rates. Produced sticky_mom_lag1 = -36.68, median_mom_lag1 = -25.68, flex_mom_lag1 = -18.77 (correct values: sticky +0.24 monthly, median +0.30 monthly-equivalent of the annualized 3.66, flex +1.11 monthly). See engine/release_forecast.py _last_n_mom_lags pre-fix and engine/release_components_cpi.py call sites.
defect_notices.consequence: Point estimates for CPI_2026-06 computed on corrupted features. June-2026 scored rows are genuine user-facing misses but are not a fair test of the frozen PREREG_V1 feature spec. All V1/V2/V3 backtests run before 2026-07-14 are contaminated by the same bug throughout the full walk-forward history and should not be used for promotion or kill decisions.

defect_notices.affects: all mf_energy shadow rows (mf_energy shadow rows begin at asof_night 2026-07-11; none exist earlier)
defect_notices.defect: energy_contrib formula applied double-discount: energy_contrib = gas_mom * (GASOLINE_RI_WEIGHT / 100.0) * gamma, but gamma is an OLS slope of cpi_hl_mom on gasoline_mom and already embeds the basket weight (slope approx ri_weight/100 approx 0.029). The extra ri_weight/100 factor shrunk energy_contrib by exactly 1/(2.895/100) = 34.5x. On the 2026-07-13 row (gas_mom -9.592, gamma 0.039165): shipped energy leg -0.0109 pp; corrected -0.3757 pp. Shipped mf_energy point was -0.206 vs actual -0.4 (corrected dry-run: -0.2701). See engine/release_mf_energy.py lines 636 and 1070 pre-fix.
defect_notices.consequence: mf_energy shadow projections effectively nullified the energy component (34.5x shrinkage) throughout the full walk-forward history; predictions were dominated by the ex-energy AR leg. All mf_energy backtest results run before 2026-07-14 reflect the defective formula and cannot support promotion or kill decisions.

defect_notices.affects: legacy CPI, core CPI, PPI, PCE, and NFP scored rows whose actual was derived by differencing separately selected output_type=4 levels
defect_notices.defect: The historical target and release-day scoring paths computed changes across independently selected initial-release index levels. The current and prior levels were not selected from one coherent release-date vintage, so annual seasonal revisions can enter the target as a synthetic print.
defect_notices.consequence: These rows remain part of the immutable all-forward record, but they cannot support model weighting, maturity, promotion, or accuracy claims. Official parsed release metrics or same-vintage full-ALFRED receipts are required for clean evaluation.

defect_notices.affects: forecast models trained on the legacy cross-vintage target epoch
defect_notices.defect: The model target sequence was built from changes across first-ever period levels rather than coherent release vintages or archived printed metrics.
defect_notices.consequence: Official actual ingestion repairs grading truth going forward, but it does not retroactively validate a model trained on a different target. These model epochs stay experimental and excluded until a separately named coherent-target challenger is refit and forward-tested.
